observations: A lean, hat-wearing figure leans sharply forward, one long arm extended right and both feet fitted with comb-like spurs, set against a flat amber-orange field.
The torso is semi-transparent: a leaf-spine rib pattern in red and white sits inside a tilted rectangular panel filled with blue, red, yellow and orange color blocks.
Lines layer in at least three weights—thick black outlines, thin white loops, and fine red curves—creating a visible stack rather than a single unified contour.
reading: The figure pitches forward as if mid-stride, its skeleton visible through a window of clashing color. The comb-toothed feet and raking right hand read as both comic and unsettling. That layered rib motif—red lines over a bright interior—gives the body a see-through quality, so the figure feels simultaneously solid and hollow. The warm amber ground keeps the mood from tipping fully into dread.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the amber ground here contrasts with the teal field of title-adjacent nnotb #30, though both share the broad-brimmed hat, skeletal figure and visible rib pattern. The collector links nnxyz's line-over-color layering to the engraved-then-filled quality of scrimshaw.
